name: Railway
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools that let an agent inspect and manage Railway deployments through the Railway public GraphQL API — verify the token, list projects and their services/environments, inspect a service's recent deployments/status and its environment variables, create a new service from a repo or image, redeploy a service, upsert environment variables, list a service's domains, add a custom domain, and read back the exact DNS records the user must set. Authenticated by a single RAILWAY_API_TOKEN (an account or workspace token; sent as Authorization: Bearer).
